description:
Recommendation: document the host-app story now that provider packages self-register and the umbrella can be consumed selectively.

Scope:
- Document how a Phoenix app depends on only the desired provider package, such as jido_connect_github, from Hex or GitHub.
- Explain that the umbrella remains a repo/publishing organization tool, while each app is a separate package/dependency.
- Document catalog discovery behavior: provider package app env registration, optional manual catalog_modules override, and when to use Catalog.discover_with_diagnostics/1.
- Include a short example showing a host app discovering only GitHub when Slack is not installed.

Primary files:
- README.md
- docs or package docs under apps/jido_connect, if present
- apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/catalog/discovery.ex docs if needed

Acceptance:
- A host Phoenix app author can tell which dependency to add for GitHub-only usage.
- Catalog discovery and diagnostics are explained without requiring the user to read source code.
title: Document host install and catalog discovery story
